bind_host.description: IP address the Metalogger listens on for incoming master connections.

bind_port.description: TCP port for incoming master connections (standard MooseFS Metalogger port).

data_path.description: Directory where changelog files and metadata dumps are stored.

working_dir.description: Working directory for metadata state (often same as data_path).

spool_dir.description: Directory for temporary metadata dump files (optional; created automatically if needed).

dump_interval.description: Interval (in seconds) between full metadata dumps to the spool directory.

max_entries.description: Maximum number of changelog entries retained; older ones are rotated.

max_age.description: Maximum age (in seconds) for changelog files before rotation.

debug_mode.description: If true, log output is printed to stdout instead of log files.

host.description: Hostname or IP of a master server.

port.description: Port used by the master server (standard is 9419).

priority.description: Connection priority (lower = higher priority); used for failover.

master_servers.description: List of MooseFS master servers to connect to for metadata replication (at least one required).

master_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for master connection attempts and operations.

master_use_ssl.description: If true, use SSL/TLS for secure communication with master servers.

master_ssl_cert.description: Path to client SSL certificate file (required only if master requires client cert).

master_ssl_key.description: Path to client SSL private key file.

master_ssl_ca.description: Path to CA certificate for verifying master server identity (if SSL enabled).

pid_file.description: Path to the PID file for the Metalogger daemon.

log_level.description: Verbosity level (0=silent to 5=debug); 4 (info) is recommended for production.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty ('') to disable file logging.
